[Nigeria Tax Act 2025, section 202, definition of "gross turnover"]

In determining whether a person meets the threshold of being a small company, the value of the supply of a capital asset of the person is excluded from taxable supplies. [Nigeria Tax Administration Act 2025, section 22(1) to (10)]

"Effective tax rate" means the rate produced by dividing the aggregate covered tax paid by a company for a year of assessment by the profits of the company. [Nigeria Tax Act 2025, section 57]

"Profits" for this purpose means the net profits before tax as reported in the audited financial statement less 5% of depreciation and personnel cost for the year. [Nigeria Tax Act 2025, section 57]
